thread.title: Millennials on Wall Street May Be Clueless on What to Do After Violent Selloffs

author: thestreet.com
title: Millennials on Wall Street May Be Clueless on What to Do After Violent Selloffs
text:
Tuesday's violent stock market selloff may have many millennials working on Wall Street unsure on what to do next. Meanwhile, it was good to see investors finally realize there are risks to investing. After all, earnings this week from Action Alerts Plus holdings Apple ( AAPL ) and Facebook ( FB ) are far from certain to blow away bullish Wall Street.
